name: Micross Components - TX, LLC
old_description: With over 40 years of in-depth expertise, Micross CMS provides an unparalleled array of hi-rel microelectronic product, packaging, test & qualification capabilities servicing the space, defense, aerospace, medical, communications, & other hi-rel markets. From pioneering RHSD in 1984, Micross remains the leader as the one source solution for component services. Turnkey & SMI available, S20.20 Certified.
about:
Micross Components - TX, LLC operates from Round Rock, Texas. The company's expertise dates to 1984 when it pioneered robotic hot solder dip (RHSD) for high-reliability microelectronics. It functions as an independent subsidiary within the Micross group, alongside Integra Technologies and SemiDice.

The facility provides a broad suite of component modification and qualification services. Core processes include BGA reballing, robotic hot solder dip, lead attach, column grid array (CGA) attachment, and lead trim/form and reconditioning. Additional capabilities span printed circuit board assembly, rework, and repair, as well as component harvesting from existing assemblies. Support services encompass tape-and-reel packaging, 3D scanning, bake-and-package cycles, marking, labeling, and kitting. The company also performs component qualification testing such as fine and gross leak detection, acoustic microscopy, X-ray inspection, and X-ray fluorescence analysis.

Customers come from space, defense, aerospace, medical, and communications sectors, along with other high-reliability markets. The company positions itself as a single-source provider for component-level services, offering turnkey programs and supplier-managed inventory (SMI) options.

Micross emphasizes its ANSI/ESD S20.20 certification and RoHS compliance as part of its quality framework. The business was built on the premise of enabling the use of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) components in high-reliability applications through modification, testing, and counterfeit mitigation.
